items.text: Josh Jacobs is practicing Thursday for the first time since training camp. Via @mattschneidman
items.priorStatus: Not practicing since training camp (facility/non-football activities only)
items.why: First regular-season practice for Jacobs; Packers beat Rob Demovsky posted video of his first handoff and sled work. Lions coordinators also said they are preparing for Jacobs.
items.implication: If Jacobs is active for Week 7, the Packers backfield of MarShawn Lloyd and Kaleb Johnson (both poor in EPA/rush per Levitan) loses value; Jacobs becomes the likely lead back.
items.opportunity: No pickup created; it lowers the value of GB backup RBs. Watch the official Thursday report and Friday designation.

items.text: Tyler Warren (groin) was not participating during the media-viewing portion of Thursday's practice. Via @KBowen1070
items.newStatus: Not participating in Thursday media-viewing period (official level pending)
items.why: Starting Colts TE absent from the open portion of Thursday practice per local radio reporter relayed by RotoWire.
items.implication: If Warren sits Week 7, the Colts' TE targets go to the backup; low fantasy value for JD unless the backup becomes a streaming option.
items.opportunity: Low; watch Friday designation before considering any IND TE fill-in.
